summary: English and Portuguese first-party discovery identified the municipal cadastral custodian and official cadastral/map routes. Public pages and configuration were inspected; the cadastral consultation requires hCaptcha and the citizen property portal requires gov.br authentication. No safe anonymous parcel geometry or native identity was obtained, so no sample GeoJSON was written.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All discovery queries, actual URLs, direct GET outcomes, hCaptcha/authentication limits, scope limits, and safe field allowlist are recorded in city-7186-indaiatuba.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credential, private-token, TLS bypass, POST submission, or unsafe-field request occurred.
